articles.title: Robert Pattinson Casts Doubt on a Crossover Between His Batman and James Gunn's Superman
articles.summary: Robert Pattinson has trouble imagining a universe where his Batman and James Gunn's Superman could co-exist, casting doubt on a potential crossover. Speaking with LADbible, Pattinson stated that he thinks it would be difficult to pluck his take on a dark, grounded Batman and drop him in James…
body: “I think it would be kind of tough to have this version of Bruce outside of that world," he said. "It's one of the only characters, I guess because of the length of the shoots, but also it's such a specific kind of [style], the tone of it gets inside you. I remember that happened to me the last time I did it, it took a while. You’re just in the dark, the whole time. Both mood-wise and light-wise, I can't see anything for like months. It does affect you, like you feel strange afterwards."

Fans have been somewhat split for a while now over whether Pattinson should also play Batman in Gunn's main DC universe, or if he should remain relegated to his own separate part of the multiverse, and it seems like Pattinson believes the latter makes the most sense. James Gunn himself has said that they're developing a Batman film that will follow an older Bruce Wayne, with Damian Wayne as his sidekick.

articles.title: Spider-Man's Jacob Batalon Explains What Destin Daniel Cretton Likes Most About Naruto and Why Team 7 Could Be the Movie's Focus
articles.summary: Jacob Batalon shed some light on what Brand New Day director Destin Daniel Cretton likes most about Naruto, giving fans a tentative idea of the direction his live-action adaptation of the iconic anime series might take.
body: Jacob Batalon, who plays Peter Parker’s bestie Ned Leeds in the Tom Holland films, sat down for an episode of The Anime Effect podcast with Crunchyroll on September 19 to chat about all things anime.
Naturally, the topic of Destin Daniel Cretton’s live-action Naruto movie came up, prompting the hosts to quiz him about what the Brand New Day director likes best about the classic anime.

Speaking from his own perspective, Batalon said that he feels like Cretton is drawn to the origin story of Team 7 — the main group of characters in the original Naruto series, initially made up of Naruto, Sasuke, Sakura, and its leader, Kakashi.

“I think he likes the aspect of Team 7 and their coming-up story,” he explained. “I think that’s really cool. I think for a lot of storytelling in movies, when you’re trying to move from a specific IP to movies meant for everyone, you have to start somewhere where everyone kind of understands where they’re coming from. I think a lot of origin story-type things are really important when you’re trying to tell a story that not everyone is accustomed to.

articles.title: Arc Raiders Is Finally Testing A PvE Mode
articles.summary: Arc Raiders developer Embark Studios has officially announced that fans of the popular extraction shooter will soon have a more cooperative-focused way to enjoy exploring topside, as a long-awaited PvE mode will be available to test from October 13-20.
body: The announcement comes three months after news that Embark was testing a unique PvE map condition on Chinese beta servers. This time around, though, players won't be forced to seek a specific map condition to get their PvE fix. Instead, a new toggle will be available during the week-long test, allowing the choice between standard matchmaking and the PvE mode.

Solos, duos, and trios will all share the same lobbies in PvE mode, as they no longer pose any threat to each other. However, Embark has stated that some major map conditions, such as Night Raids, Hidden Bunker, Locked Gate, and Frigate, will remain only available in standard matchmaking.
In a press release, Embark has clarified that there is no guarantee a permanent PvE mode will come to Arc Raiders.

"It’s possible that this will not work," the release says. "This test is not a promise that there will be a PvE mode in the future, but take this as an indication that we are seriously considering it. We don’t yet know how the potential future version of this setting might look. It’s plausible that any future version could look very different from what you experience in the beta test."

articles.title: March 2027 Could Be Make-Or-Break For Marathon
articles.summary: Bungie has big plans to revive not only Destiny 2, but to also evolve its extraction shooter, Marathon. Following its launch in March 2026, the studio says that it has been reviewing feedback around Marathon, and it revealed how it plans to evolve the experience as it heads toward a big update in…
body: One of Bungie's major points of focus is a Marathon experience that is more than just an extraction shooter. "PvEvP will remain an important part of Marathon, but it will become one point in a connected set of survival experiences," Bungie wrote in a blog post. "More approachable entry points will help new and returning players understand Marathon’s systems and build confidence before taking on its highest-stakes challenges. At the same time, experienced players will have more opportunities to test their mastery and pursue deeper challenges."

Bungie says it's building out connected PvE, PvP, and PvEvP experiences, as well as options for solo players and crews. A Nightfall Refresh is coming in October and the Symbiosis expansion will add more ways to play in December. Bungie will connect all these pieces together in a big March 2027 update. This will also include deeper progression systems for players, a refactored Cradle, a new onboarding experience, more narrative beats to discover, new enemies to battle, and an entirely new zone to explore.

articles.title: Control Resonant Is Making Dylan Stronger, Even If He Just Woke Up From A Coma
articles.summary: Control Resonant has officially launched, and Remedy Entertainment has also paired it with a fresh patch to make it a little less brutal. Hotfix 1.3.3 is primarily focused on adjusting enemy health pools and Dylan's overall strength, and once it's installed, you can expect the parautilitarian to…
body: "We strongly believe these changes will improve the gameplay feel and flow while still providing a challenge," developer Remedy Entertainment wrote in the hotfix notes. "Depending on player progression, enemies can feel too tanky during the early hours of the game."

Applying a "Falter" status to the enemy Hiss in Control Resonant is a crucial part of the overall gameplay loop, as it sets them up for an instant-kill finisher. Once the hotfix is active, the base health and required Falter level for enemies will be reduced, while Aberrant strength and maximum Ability strength will be increased.

Remedy says that it also wants to encourage buildcrafting and experimentation in the game, so it's permanently reducing the cost of respeccing and increasing the stock of the Reset Items across all vendors in the game. The first Resonant boss fight (The Artist) will also drop two Reset Items instead of one.

articles.title: All Xbox rumors, changes, and cancelled games in 2026 (so far)
articles.summary: The last several months have been a roller coaster for Xbox. On Sept. 22, chief content officer Matt Booty disclosed 268 more layoffs, as well as the consolidation of smaller studios like Obsidian and Rare into larger ones, namely Bethesda and Activision.
body: It may take weeks or even months until we get an exact picture of all the changes taking place at Xbox, but here's what we know. The stories below are presented in reverse chronological order, so the newest developments will appear at the top.

In an internal memo following news of the Sept. 22 changes, Bethesda Game Studios head Jill Braff said, "Today’s announcement is primarily a change in reporting structure. The creative identity and strengths that make Obsidian distinct will remain at the core of their studio and work."

While Obsidian seems likely to survive and not be transformed into a support studio for Bethesda, it probably won't enjoy the same freedom to experiment that it has enjoyed in years past. Elsewhere in the memo, Braff foregrounded the two studios' collaboration on an upcoming Fallout project, noting that "this structure supports the franchise-led model we’ve been strengthening while keeping accountability for both the studio and the franchise clear."

articles.title: Stranger Than Heaven Studio Made The Tupac Resurrection Less Weird By Not Using AI
articles.summary: RGG Studio's Stranger Than Heaven is certainly living up to its title, as the decision to resurrect the late rapper Tupac Shakur as a character in the game was perceived as odd when it was first announced at Summer Game Fest.
body: "RGG Studio is treating this integration with the utmost respect for his legacy, crafting every aspect in close collaboration and without the use of AI, including his character design based on archival footage and photographs," the studio wrote. More details on the character who uses Shakur's likeness, Amaru, will be shared at a later date.

According to RGG Studio head Masayoshi Yokoyama, it was Snoop Dogg himself who suggested Tupac for the role. The rapper also appears in Stranger Than Heaven, where his official character description notes that he plays the globe-trotting merchant Orpheus, who has an "open mind" about the legality of his wares. In the game, Orpheus discovers that the protagonist, Daito, has stowed away aboard his ship, and he mentors him in the harsh life that awaits him on his way to 1915 Japan.

The rest of the game's cast also features a varied and talented selection of performers from across the globe, including musicians Tori Kelly and Satoshi Fujihara, Shogun actor Tokuma Nishioka, and famed voice actor Akio Otsuka. You can expect to encounter all of them throughout the game's story, which covers 50 years of history.

articles.title: Where to find bitter leaves in Fire Emblem Fortune's Weave
articles.summary: As you look for bitter leaves in Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave, you will find yourself traveling to the four corners of the game's map. Even though this is not a rare material, there are only a few locations where you can find it.
body: Here's a list with all the nodes where you can find bitter leaves in Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave.

There are four nodes in Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave from which you can collect bitter leaves. Most of them are considerably far from Dagsion, so make sure you have enough turns to reach the node before any deadlines.

One of the closest nodes to the early areas in the game is Traveler's Garden. You will find it in the northeast corner of the map, in the Castalia region. Although it takes a while to get there if you haven't unlocked the Eochaid Posthouse, once you do, visiting the node and collecting some bitter leaves will take only a few turns.

On the other side of the map, in the Solidus region, you will find the Cape Nereus node. By searching this one, you can find not only bitter leaves, but also pepper leaves. The quickest way to reach this node, if you have already explored the region, is by using a carriage to Aragona Posthouse.

articles.title: 2 Months Later, Marvel Finally Releases Spider-Man: Brand New Day’s Post-Credits Scene
articles.summary: Avengers: Endgame Encore, Disney’s re-release of its blockbuster ensemble film, has finally explained one of the most glaring unanswered questions left at the tail end of Spider-Man: Brand New Day.
body: One such character who makes a surprise appearance is Bruce Banner (Mark Ruffalo).

Last seen getting carted off on a stretcher after turning into the Hulk and rampaging through the Department of Damage Control (DODC) headquarters, Banner’s whereabouts and general status were left to the imagination at the end of Brand New Day. Seeing as he caused widespread panic across New York City and potentially even injured several witnesses, it was safe to assume he was locked up tight after his short-lived cameo scenes.

However, one post-credits scene at the end of Avengers: Endgame Encore changes everything. The stinger features Banner in a secure facility seemingly of his own design. He pans the camera around a solid stone ceiling, highlighting its structural integrity and subterranean nature, claiming with a positive zeal that, “Hulk isn’t getting out of here, and no one else is getting in.” Banner adds that he’s “been experimenting with a new gamma suppression serum,” something that might hold weight in future Marvel movies.
points: Avengers: Endgame Encore, Disney’s re-release of its blockbuster ensemble film, has finally explained one of the most glaring unanswered questions left at the tail end of Spider-Man: Brand New Day.

articles.title: The Blood of Dawnwalker's divisive time mechanic was once much stricter, but it was loosened because of "fear" around the game
articles.summary: I've had a hunch ever since playing The Blood of Dawnwalker that its divisive time limit feature - whereby you have 30 in-game days and nights to save your character's family from a nasty pack of vampires - isn't as strict as Rebel Wolves once intended it. And it turns out I was right.
body: I shared the hunch with game director Konrad Tomaszkiewicz in a recent interview, explaining that I'd found the time limit overly generous when I reviewed The Blood of Dawnwalker. I rarely had to seriously deliberate about what I wanted to do and I defeated the final boss with only half my allotted time used.

The full-game experience was in stark contrast to that of the game's prologue, where time is severely limited and you do have to choose your quests carefully. My question to Tomazkiewicz was whether he and Rebel Wolves pulled back on this approach in response to public concern after the game was announced.

His response caught me slightly off guard. "Obviously!" he said, as if I'd asked him something ludicrously, well, obvious. "Obviously. Yes. We had at first a more restricted time where it was harder to beat the game, but after all of those voices, before release even, we knew that it can be a problem and we rebalanced it this way to give the buffer for the people to not fear this.

articles.title: Bungie Officially Reveals Massive Marathon Revamp With New PvE Mode
articles.summary: Days after Bungie announced it was planning to bring back Destiny 2 and "evolve" Marathon, the studio revealed more about what the latter half of that plan means. In a lengthy blog post, the developer outlined plans for the next year of Marathon, including the addition of the game's first dedicated…
body: The multi-month plan to evolve Marathon focuses on transitioning the game from a "cutthroat, winner-takes-all PvEvP experience" to something that supports a broader audience, Bungie says.

"Some players want a quick, lower-pressure run after work," game director Del Chafe III and creative director Julia Nardin wrote in a blog post. "Some want to spend an entire night with their crew. Others want to test a build, compete directly against other players, chase a difficult challenge, or follow a strange clue deeper into the ruins of Tau Ceti IV.

After the Nightfall refresh arrives in Marathon in October, Bungie will move on to the game's Symbiosis update, due in December. Symbiosis is a "significant step into the future" of Marathon and will include "more ways to play, more approachable ways to learn the game, and more opportunities to explore Tau Ceti IV in lower-pressure environments," according to Bungie. Marathon’s first permanent PvE mode will be added as part of Symbiosis, offering a space where players can "explore, experiment, and take on challenges without worrying about being hunted by other Runners."

articles.title: "It genuinely breaks my heart"- Confusion and frustration reign as gaming communities react to Xbox's drastic restructuring this week
articles.summary: It's been another difficult week for Xbox and the many studios it operates, as a second wave of layoffs has ripped through the company. The saddest news surrounds the impending closure of Hellblade studio Ninja Theory, but layoffs have all but dismantled Halo Studios and halved Age of Empires…
body: However, that's not all that happened. Besides the layoffs, there's been notable restructuring of the Xbox division, effectively re-delegating the management of studios away from Xbox directly, to either Bethesda or Activision - publishing operations Xbox owns. Obsidian moved to Bethesda, while Rare, World's Edge and Halo moved to Activision.

Since the news, there's been an outpouring of concern from the communities of each studio's games, some wondering if Activision will operate these new businesses as it does Call of Duty, and more aggressively monetise their games, while others are questioning whether Obsidian will now have freedom to make anything that isn't Bethesda-related.

Ninja Theory still hasn't said anything publicly related to the studio's impending closure, nor have any of the key figures there. Understandably, the sentiment on the Hellblade subreddit is sad, with an announcement post labelling it "devastating".

videos.summary: Check out the trailer for V/H/S/MIXTAPE, an upcoming horror film featuring new segments from directors Ernest Dickerson, Flying Lotus, Tobias Forge, David Moreau, RZA, and Renee Zhan.
body: V/H/S/MIXTAPE cranks the franchise's signature found-footage horror up to eleven with an electrifying new anthology where music and sound become the source of terror. United by a theme that explores the power of music, rhythm, and audio to haunt, possess, transform, and destroy, the film blends cosmic horror, psychological suspense, outrageous splatter, and groundbreaking practical effects into one unforgettable mixtape of nightmares.
points: Check out the trailer for V/H/S/MIXTAPE, an upcoming horror film featuring new segments from directors Ernest Dickerson, Flying Lotus, Tobias Forge, David Moreau, RZA, and Renee Zhan.
The latest installment pushes the boundaries of found footage with four wildly original stories that each put a unique spin on the terrifying relationship between sound and fear.
V/HS/MIXTAPE features GWAR and Jim Henson's Creature Shop.

videos.title: FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE – Tokyo Game Show Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
videos.summary: Pre-order and play the free demo for FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE now on Nintendo Switch 2:
body: Take a first look at content and features included in the first HD 2D FINAL FANTASY!

The pixel-art world of FINAL FANTASY returns in this reimagined adventure! The world is full of secrets, including the wandering swordmaster Gilgamesh, a Colosseum with deadly monsters and rewards to match, the Chamber of Arms with formidable foes sealed within legendary weapons, and a showdown with Ultima Weapon. Try out the first chapter in the free demo!
Visit Nintendo.com for more info:
